text_block_list.name: Security Guard A
text_block_list.text:
The kids at Tracen Academy really are such 
good children, you know? Hardly any of 
them ever break curfew.

text_block_list.name: Security Guard B
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally. Our job's practically 
nothing to do. *yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Security Guard A
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Was that the wind?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(During all that time I spent hesitating, 
a gap must have formed between me and 
those who kept seriously honing their 
legs...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I have to run more. Otherwise... there 
won't be victory. So...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —It's my turn, then.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Fufufufufufufu...! 
FufufufufuFUFUFU...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... How comfortable. ...I'm alright.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You wish to win, do you not? You want to 
bring joy to that person, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'll devour everything for you. So don't 
worry...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Go to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu...! Ahahahaha♡ No one can hold me 
back――ever again!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The hunger has been sated. Next... we 
become one!!

—I bolted upright in bed. My heart was 
pounding wildly... Did I have a nightmare? 
No—

...I have a headache. I shook my head and 
closed my eyes once more, but— no matter 
how much I prayed after that... I couldn't 
sleep.
choice_data_list: （それよりも、もっと甘美なナニカが……）
choice_data_list_en: (No, something even sweeter than that...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-san. ...Um...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right? You don't seem to be 
looking very well...
choice_data_list: I couldn't really sleep last night...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Will you be taking today 
off...?
choice_data_list: 昨日、あまり眠れなくて……
choice_data_list_en: I couldn't sleep very well last night...

text_block_list.text:
In fact, Still in Love seemed to be 
shining all the brighter as of late. Her 
training was on the upswing, and her 
spirits were high.
choice_data_list: やろう。……君は調子がよさそうだし
やろう。……貴方は調子がよさそうだし
choice_data_list_en: Let's do it. ...You seem to be in great shape, after all.
Let's do it. ...You seem to be in great shape, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: （走ると決めて、よかったのかな……）
choice_data_list_en: (Was it really the right choice to decide to run...?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes. Please, don't overexert yourself...
choice_data_list_en: ! ...Shall we start warming up?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!

Still in Love raced across the track with 
fierce determination... with a sharpness 
that made it hard to believe she had been 
thinking of stepping away from racing.
choice_data_list:
(She's in way better shape than she was 
for the Kinko Sho...!)

text_block_list.text:
Slowly, steadily... she accelerates. As 
the running girl's silhouette wavers in 
crimson—
choice_data_list: （『金鯱賞』の時よりはるかにいい……！）
choice_data_list_en: (She's in far better shape than back at the "Kinko Sho"...!)

text_block_list.text:
She appears. The intensity of the running 
surges, more... More, more... More, more, 
more—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list_en: (Makes you want to keep watching...—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um... It's finished, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps you should take a short rest 
after all...? Your complexion is growing 
worse by the second..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Ah, that run just now...?
choice_data_list: いや、それより……すごくよかったぞ！
いや、それより……すごくよかったよ！
choice_data_list_en: No, more importantly... that was amazing!
No, more importantly... that was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ! Is that so...?
choice_data_list: うん。もっと伸びていけそうだな
うん。もっと伸びていけそうだね
choice_data_list_en: Yeah. Looks like there's still plenty of room to grow.
Yeah. Seems like you can grow even more.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm happy. It feels like... I can 
become even stronger."
choice_data_list: I can't wait for the next race!
I can't wait for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Indeed...
choice_data_list: 次のレースが待ちきれないな！
次のレースが待ちきれないね！
choice_data_list_en: I can't wait for the next race!
I can't wait for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "In the end— this was for the best."

And so, training progressed smoothly, and 
as if in proportion to Still in Love 
shining brighter with each passing day—
Something had started happening to me.
(Bee-bee-bee-bee-beep...)

First, I've had more trouble sleeping at 
night. I finally drift off a bit toward 
morning, which leaves me groggy upon 
waking... It's a vicious cycle.
choice_data_list_en: …………Whoa, it's already this late!

text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Is that all you're having for 
lunch?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Half a boiled egg, chicken breast. 
Tomato juice...

My appetite dropped, and my weight 
gradually decreased. I try to get creative 
to at least get nutrients, but... whenever 
I force myself to eat, it comes right back 
up.
choice_data_list: 今日はお腹が空かなくて
choice_data_list_en: I just haven't been very hungry today.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but you barely ate anything 
yesterday either...
choice_data_list_en: I'll eat tomorrow.

text_block_list.text: And furthermore—

My heart pounds, and a haze clouds my 
thoughts. —I want to see her run. Right 
now... I want to see it.
choice_data_list_en: (...—Not again. My head...)

text_block_list.text:
I wanna see I wanna see I wanna see I 
wanna see I wanna see I wanna see I wanna 
see I wanna see I wanna see I wanna see I 
wanna see I wanna see I wanna see I wanna 
see I wanna see I wanna see I wanna see I 
wanna see I wanna see

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me!!!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text: "Senpai! Were you listening!?"
choice_data_list: Ah... S-Sorry. What was that again?

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"So, the trainee I was recently assigned 
to has been super harsh with me—"
choice_data_list: あ……ご、ごめん。なんだっけ
choice_data_list_en: Ah... S-Sorry. What was it again?

text_block_list.text:
Even in the middle of a conversation, at 
any given moment... out of nowhere, my 
mind goes blank... and I end up thinking 
far too much about Still in Love's 
running—
And the ultimate highlight is—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, this looks good. I'll accept it from 
here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Well then, good wo—
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます
choice_data_list_en: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my goodness! A-Are you all 
right...!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, your eyes... Your irises are—
choice_data_list_en: Huh? W-what is it...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Bright red...

The redness in her eyes faded quickly, but 
just to be safe, we went to the 
hospital... and they said there were no 
abnormalities.

Anxiety creeps in. But without knowing the 
cause... all we can do is wait for her 
symptoms to settle. It might just be a 
temporary slump.
choice_data_list_en: (Hmm... I wonder what's wrong.)

text_block_list.text:
The next day. Still unable to sleep and 
with a fuzzy, heavy head, lunchtime 
arrived. And then...
choice_data_list: （あまり深刻に捉えないようにしよう）
choice_data_list_en: (I shouldn't take this too seriously.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I made a boxed lunch for you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list_en: For me?
For me?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I've packed it focusing mainly on items 
with delightful fragrances and vibrant 
colors.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I hope this helps stimulate your appetite, 
even just a little...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...This kind of thing is really... all I 
can do, after all."
choice_data_list_en: Still...

text_block_list.text:
As I accept it, I make a silent vow. To 
keep her from worrying any further... 
Whatever happens next—I will stay silent.
choice_data_list_en: Thank you. ...Don't mind if I do.
